subject.title: [Bug]: Assistant text preceding a tool call in the same turn is silently dropped on Signal channel (Anthropic/Sonnet, non-streaming)

question: Should this report be owned as the canonical OpenClaw runtime bug for same-turn pre-tool-call text delivery, and should the fix flush the text or explicitly signal intentional suppression to the agent?
rationale: The report is credible and aligned with stability priorities, but this checkout does not contain the Signal delivery implementation and the issue offers two materially different runtime semantics.

options.title: Own as runtime bug
options.body: Keep this issue as the canonical runtime/channel bug and decide the no-silent-drop invariant before implementation.

options.title: Document intentional suppression
options.body: If pre-tool text must stay suppressed, require an agent-visible note plus user-facing docs so transcripts cannot imply delivery.

options.title: Consolidate duplicate
options.body: Link or close https://github.com/openclaw/clawhub/issues/2992 against this older identical report so discussion stays in one place.

recommendation.title: Own as runtime bug
recommendation.body: Keep this issue as the canonical runtime/channel bug and decide the no-silent-drop invariant before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The current VISION/README scope and channel-priority text are attributed to this history, making this the best local owner for deciding repo routing and product semantics.
